guide_solution: (a) Environment pollution has become a serious problem in our country. (b) Owing to setting up mills and factories indiscriminately over the past decades, the environment problem here has become more acute. (c) Air is constantly being polluted by smoke from industrial plants, brick-kilns and motor vehicles. (d) However, people living in urban areas suffer most owing to these pollutions. (e) We have to be careful using vehicles and selecting sites for setting up mills and factories. (f) Suitable lubricants should be used with a view to decreasing the level of emission and pollutants. (g) Dangerous mills and factories including brick-kilns in busy areas should be relocated to lessen pollution.
